definition: To import is to bring another module's definitions into the current one.
A call is one function invoking another.
Containment is a class or module holding a member (a method, attribute, or nested definition).
Inheritance is one class deriving its structure and behaviour from another.
A test is code that exercises another unit and checks its behaviour.
A definition is where a name (a class, function, or variable) is introduced.
A touch is a commit changing a file or a symbol in the codebase.
Change-coupling is two files that tend to be changed together in the same commits.
A re-export is a module passing another module's definition through as part of its own public API.
A service edge is one part of the codebase providing or backing another, such as a handler serving a route.
A denotation is a vocabulary term naming a code entity, linking the word to the thing it refers to.
